title: Contextual Evaluation of Large Language Models for Classifying Tropical and Infectious Diseases

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual location substitution in patient personas (e.g., replacing endemic locations with non-endemic ones like San Francisco) to measure the impact on model diagnostic accuracy.
Counterfactual race substitution (Asian, Black, White) in patient personas to evaluate changes in model diagnostic performance.
Counterfactual gender substitution (male, female, non-binary) in patient personas to evaluate changes in model diagnostic performance.
Comparing model diagnostic accuracy on medical prompts translated from English to French.
